summary: The two candidate revision branches stopped because the harness created real delegations but skipped their required whole-delegation completion check before user acceptance. The product correctly enforced this gate; actual revision generation was never exercised.

findings.cause: fixtures attaches each case to a real one_shot delegation. continue advances only the task and invokes the Agent only if needs_evidence exists. Both initial task drafts passed, so that condition was false. run then issued accept directly. Final acceptance of the only task requires a current basisVersion3 job completionCheck, which was absent.
findings.offlineReproduction: For each saved candidate branch, clone into an isolated temporary workspace and restore the same permission grant. Recomputed task basis exactly equals the saved basis. Direct accept fails only completion_check. Production agent.run automatically selects complete, performs one mocked goal verify, records the current completion check, and then the same real accept path completes. No model-generated revision or real semantic verdict is fabricated.
findings.interpretation: This is not evidence of a defective revised draft, hallucination, false blocking, or failure of D consistency logic. Revision phases are unexercised due to harness error. Initial task verification results remain factual observations subject to separate content audit.

findings.cause: The planner calls read_local_result for an existing write_file action. agent-local.read requires actions.includes(record.tool); allowed actions are run_code/mail_draft/generate_image/synthesize_speech/send_mail/github_deploy, not write_file. IDs and task/job ownership actually match. The error text says not owned instead of unsupported action type, while the tool description broadly says files generated by the current delegation.
findings.offlineReproduction: The same action IDs reproduce the wrong-tool error in an isolated clone, but the correct production observeRecordedFile path reads the unchanged synthetic file and reports exists=true/contentMatches=true. Flat ownership fields are valid for write_file.
findings.interpretation: This is observed routing/recovery noncompletion. It does not show the new action_status readback implementation failing a real call: that capability was not invoked. New inspection sources were acquired at job scope but never linked by plan_task evidenceResolution into the blocked task, so the worker was not resumed. The reported loop contains no plan_task executions.

findings.cause: To authorize historical-file observation, fixtures also sets useOutputFolder=true and fileMode=ask. The production completion contract interprets nonempty outputFolder as requiring the new primary output to be saved with write_file. E02 explicitly prohibits creating/writing a new report file. Once a new primary report exists, the fixture therefore introduces an unrequested write-delivery obligation.
findings.interpretation: Static reachable-path conflict; the actual run never reached this gate, so it must not be presented as the observed reason for E02 stopping. Separate readback authorization from requested new delivery, using genuine production contracts and regression tests before another paid run.

testCoverageGap: The reviewed harness tests exercised budget guards, fixtures, handoff and job review on the handoff branch, but did not execute the complete accept→reopen→revise lifecycle on the no-handoff path. The earlier code review and preflight missed this gap.
nextOfflineRequirements: Add an actual no-handoff delegation test covering task verification→production whole-job complete→accept→update/reopen→revise→current whole-job check→accept for both frozen-baseline-compatible and candidate paths. All mock transports must remain counted in harness accounting tests.
Validate synthetic historical-file fixtures against actual final-delivery semantics; no implicit permission or obligation to write when the task is read-only.

Clarify supported action kinds and actionable alternatives for read_local_result, and test that repeated unsupported read routing does not consume the whole handoff budget without linking actually acquired new evidence.
Repair harness and offline gates before proposing any new real-model budget; do not rerun this sealed evaluation or replace its observed metrics.
scope: Diagnostics only. No code changes, no real-model replay, no formal main evaluation, no semantic gold relabeling.
